name: Knee Stretches

load.note: One red makes it a core exercise; two or more shifts the work to the thighs and gets the heart rate up.

summary: Kneeling on the carriage with hands on the footbar, push the carriage back with the legs.
steps: Hands on the footbar shoulder-width apart, feet against the shoulder rests.
Knees hover just off the carriage; head and hips at the same height.
Breathe out to push the carriage back with the legs.
Breathe in to bring the knees back under the hips.

cautions.note: Kneeling on the carriage; pad the knees or swap.
Round-back version is loaded flexion; teach flat back only.

cues:
From the waist up nothing moves.
Look just ahead of the footbar.
Soft elbows; shoulders don't round.
Step the feet further down the carriage if you need more room.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Knees off (Bear)
variations.note: Knees hover a few centimetres off the carriage.

variations.name: Knees resting on the carriage for sore backs or wrists
Less spring spares the legs but asks more of the core
